title: 32 km inversion, 30 L-BFGS-B iterations under scpc_gamg with one paused solver, counting rank 0's live Python objects after taped solves 10 and 30: where is the remaining RSS growth
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=0 (one annotated solve at full n an evaluation)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb); ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; no dH/dt term
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs; alone on the machine (no other session's process in a 10 s CPU log)
resources: 8 ranks; RSS a rank (mean over ranks) 1199 MiB after the first taped solve, 1256 MiB after the last
cost: the gc.get_objects() sweeps add a few seconds on rank 0 at two solves
results: /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_runs/inversion_solver_reuse_32km/L_new_obj/ (map.h5 sha256 24a13739, log.txt with the [objcount] lines, timing.json)
audit: over 20 evaluations the bytes in rank 0's live PyOP2 Dats stayed 1.8 MiB and no Function, Cofunction or petsc4py object accumulated; what grew is small: 80 tlm_adjoint Functionals with their Caches and FloatSpaces (4 an evaluation) and about 3,200 functions and 6,200 closure cells. The dof-proportional growth is in memory Python does not see (PETSc, Slate or the allocator)
